baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive encompassing of his yield together with the garden lying fallen upon its trellises.
baseline_models.mechanism: Overwhelming enclosure takes the growing yield as wealth and ends by collapsing the productive canopy onto the supports that made it possible.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies overwhelming enclosure ending in ruin, making the passive event total rather than local.
The growing-wealth branch makes the object productive capital, not fruit alone.
The collapse branch supplies the downward failure of the garden's built order.
The vine-trellis branch identifies the supports on which the productive canopy depended.

changed_reading.before: A crop is destroyed and its owner laments the damage.
changed_reading.after: His whole yield-capital is overtaken, and the productive system collapses onto its own supports.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated turning of both palms over what he had spent in the garden.
baseline_models.mechanism: Face-to-face turning, literal palms, and expenditure as outgoing wealth make the gesture a recursive bodily audit: the hands that disbursed capital now display its absence.

activation_trace.role: Repeated face-to-face turning supplies the oscillating audit motion.
The literal palms embody what remains available to him after the outflow.
Expenditure as money leaving anchors the gesture in sunk investment.

changed_reading.before: He wrings his hands in regret.
changed_reading.after: His body performs a loss audit: the spending hands cycle over an investment that can no longer return to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: His spoken wish that he had associated no one with his Lord.
baseline_models.mechanism: The overlap between partnership, theological association, and lordship as ownership turns the confession into a correction of agency: no asset, ally, or claimant shares the Lord's governance.

activation_trace.role: The partnership branch exposes the shared-agency structure being revoked.
The theological-association branch fixes that revocation as a confession about God.
Lordship as ownership and mastery identifies the sole governing claimant.
The negative-context branch exhausts the class of possible partners without exception.

changed_reading.before: Material ruin prompts a generic renunciation of idolatry.
changed_reading.after: Ruin forces a proprietary correction: the wealth he treated as co-agent never shared the Lord's ownership or power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden begins inside a beneficial palm-ring, while an earlier punitive scene supplies destructive enclosure; at the focus, enclosure changes sides and takes the yield itself as its target.

activation_trace.role: The earlier occurrence supplies an active, overwhelming enclosure around wrongdoers.
The surrounding pavilion gives that punitive enclosure a bounded spatial form.
The ring around a center supplies the garden's original protective palm boundary.
The focus passive transfers overwhelming enclosure from an outer threat to the yield itself.

structural_cues: The window first presents destructive enclosure in 18:29, then a beneficial ring around the gardens in 18:32, then passive enclosure of the yield in 18:42.
The grammatical patient at the focus is the yield, so the former protected center becomes what is trapped.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: punitive enclosure and a palm-ring precede the focus passive. Reader arrow: the beneficial perimeter reverses into destructive capture. Alternative: the two enclosure scenes may remain parallel images without a deliberate reversal.

changed_reading.before: An external calamity happens to a well-protected garden.
changed_reading.after: The protection-image is inverted: the ring that marked secured abundance becomes a total enclosure from which the yield cannot escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier heedless heart follows its inclination; at the focus, no inner heart turns, but the owner's palms do. The missed inward reorientation is displaced into futile outward rotation.

activation_trace.role: The lapse from vigilance supplies the earlier interior failure.
The heart as understanding identifies the organ whose orientation had failed.
Inclination of the self supplies the directional pull followed by that heart.
The focus converts turning into a visible, repeated motion of the hands.
The two palms locate the belated reversal outside the heart.

structural_cues: The same QLB root names the heedless heart in 18:28 and the hand-turning action in 18:42.
The earlier sequence runs heart to desire; the later sequence runs hands to spent capital.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a heedless heart follows desire, then palms repeatedly turn. Reader arrow: bodily rotation externalizes a reorientation the heart failed to make. Alternative: hand-turning may function only as a conventional regret gesture.

changed_reading.before: The palms merely display grief after the loss.
changed_reading.after: The body belatedly performs the change of direction that the desire-led heart did not perform in time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owner's projected better return or outcome and his later repeated hand-turning share QLB: an anticipated profitable turn is answered by involuntary physical turning after loss.

activation_trace.role: The return-and-outcome branch supplies the better result he had projected for himself.
The face-to-face reversal branch makes the projected turn reappear as repeated bodily motion.

structural_cues: The nominal outcome in 18:36 and the intensive turning verb in 18:42 share QLB.
The boast about a better outcome precedes the collapse and the turning of empty hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same root marks expected outcome and later hand-turning. Reader arrow: the second occurrence materially ironizes the first. Alternative: ordinary polysemy may explain the recurrence without an intended lexical answer.

changed_reading.before: His expectation of a better outcome and his later regret are separate moments.
changed_reading.after: His imagined favorable turn comes back inverted: projected return becomes the repetitive turning by which he realizes there is no return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The companion's earlier present-tense refusal to associate anyone with his Lord returns after collapse as the owner's counterfactual wish, making the confession delayed uptake rather than an isolated discovery.

activation_trace.role: The earlier theological refusal supplies the creed later echoed by the owner.
Repeated lordship fixes the earlier statement around the same governing relation.
Exhaustive negation completes the earlier formula that the focus wish repeats.
The focus changes the earlier live refusal into a wish about a missed choice.
The same exhaustive endpoint makes the verbal echo resolvable.

structural_cues: 18:38 and 18:42 share the sequence Lord, associate, anyone with only polarity and speaker-position changed.
The companion states the creed before the predicted calamity; the owner wishes for it only after the calamity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a near-identical formula is spoken earlier by the companion and later by the ruined owner. Reader arrow: the latter is belated uptake of the former. Alternative: both speakers may independently use a fixed monotheistic formula.

changed_reading.before: The owner independently discovers the right confession when ruin arrives.
changed_reading.after: He finally voices, in counterfactual regret, the exact stance already offered to him before the ruin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The boast of a stronger supporting group is answered by the absence of any faction able to help; the focus renunciation of any partner sits at the hinge where social capital is exposed as non-saving.

activation_trace.role: The supporting-group branch supplies the human backing in which the owner boasted.
Partnership language lets the confession revoke reliance on co-agents as well as possessions.
Exhaustive negation removes every candidate partner from the saving role.
A faction returning to its head gives concrete group form to the support that is absent.
Aid and making support manifest state the exact capacity his faction lacks.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from stronger group in 18:34, through the focus confession, to no helping faction in 18:43.
The indefinite 'anyone' in the focus is immediately tested by the total absence of human aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a supporting-group boast precedes the confession and explicit non-support follows it. Reader arrow: the confession marks collapse of a social partnership model, not wealth alone. Alternative: 18:43 may simply narrate helplessness without expanding the sense of association in 18:42.

changed_reading.before: He regrets a private theological error while separately losing his supporters.
changed_reading.after: The confession also registers failed social capital: neither wealth nor the stronger group can act as a saving partner beside his Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-maps literal palms to the scale-pan branch and reads the sent hasban through accounting. It remains anchored in both palms, what he spent, and the packet's counting branch at 18:40. Render it only as an exploratory lexical overlay, not as the local lexical sense of either word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both palms turning over the expenditure after the predicted hasban reaches the garden.

activation_trace.role: The counting-and-account branch lets the sent calamity activate a counter-reckoning of the owner's investment.
The containing scale-pan branch lets the two empty palms resemble an improvised balance.
Actual expenditure keeps the balance image tied to the verse's economic object.

changed_reading.before: He looks at his hands while regretting sunk expenditure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the empty palms become balance pans after a counter-reckoning: his private ledger is weighed by an event he did not control.

strongest_changes: The garden's protective enclosure reverses into an enclosure that captures its yield.
The hoped-for better return is answered by the repeated turning of the owner's palms.
The final confession becomes a belated echo of the companion's earlier creed and a recognition that social backing cannot save.
summary.what_was_special: The trace is driven by reversible spatial and lexical machinery: enclosure changes sides, QLB moves from heart to outcome to hands, and the same no-partner formula changes speaker and tense after collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: The QLB recurrence strongly supports irony, but ordinary polysemy remains a live explanation.
The link between punitive enclosure in 18:29 and the yield's enclosure in 18:42 is structurally strong but not made explicit.
The economic-partnership and empty-balance readings are activated by packet branches and should not be presented as exclusive lexical senses.
